post.summary: Open an account for a customer, in one currency
post.description: Opening the same account again, for the same holder and currency, is accepted and changes nothing.

200.description: The operation ran. `status` is `ok` with the output, or `error` with one of the business errors this operation declares.

post.description: Send an Idempotency-Key: a deposit retried with the same key is booked once.

200.description: The operation ran. `status` is `ok` with the output, or `error` with one of the business errors this operation declares.

post.summary: Pay money out of an account, never beyond what is available
post.description: Send an Idempotency-Key: a withdrawal retried with the same key is booked once.

200.description: The operation ran. `status` is `ok` with the output, or `error` with one of the business errors this operation declares.

post.summary: Close an account with nothing left in it

200.description: The operation ran. `status` is `ok` with the output, or `error` with one of the business errors this operation declares.

post.summary: Ask to move money from one of your accounts to another account
post.description: The transfer is accepted at once and carried out in the background: follow it with transfer-status. The caller must hold the paying account. The transfer id is the caller's, so a retry never pays twice.

200.description: The operation ran. `status` is `ok` with the output, or `error` with one of the business errors this operation declares.

200.description: The operation ran. `status` is `ok` with the output, or `error` with one of the business errors this operation declares.

post.summary: Run several commands in one request
post.description: Items run in order and independently: each has its own outcome, and a failed item does not stop the rest. Not atomic.

200.description: One result per item, in order.

post.summary: Run several queries in one request
post.description: Items run in order and independently: each has its own outcome, and a failed item does not stop the rest. Not atomic.

200.description: One result per item, in order.

get.description: Whether the service should be sent traffic: every readiness check passes, and it is not shutting down.

503.description: A dependency is down, or the service is draining.

ProblemDetails.description: RFC 9457 problem details. Used only for protocol-level failures, never for business outcomes.

holder.description: The customer's user id at the identity provider

AccountAlreadyOpened.description: An account with this id exists. Opening it again with the same holder and currency is accepted.

AccountNotOpen.description: The account was never opened, or has been closed.

InsufficientFunds.description: Accounts never go overdrawn: the amount exceeds what is available, holds deducted.

closed.description: False when it was already closed

AccountNotEmpty.description: Only an account with a zero balance and no transfer in flight can be closed.

TransferIdInUse.description: Requesting the same transfer again is accepted; reusing its id for another transfer is not.

available.description: The balance less outgoing transfers in flight

entry.description: The entry's place in the account's history

amount.description: Signed: money in is positive, money out negative

reference.description: The deposit's or withdrawal's reference, or the transfer id

counterparty.description: The account on the other side of a transfer

bearer.description: An access token from the bank's identity provider.

BadRequest.description: The body is not valid JSON or does not match the operation's input schema.

PayloadTooLarge.description: The batch has more items than the service accepts.

Unauthenticated.description: The operation needs an authenticated caller and the request has no valid credentials.

Forbidden.description: The caller lacks a permission the operation requires (see `x-projected-access`).

Conflict.description: Retry later: the command raced with another change to the same data (`concurrency-conflict`), or a request with the same idempotency key is still running (`request-in-progress`).

IdempotencyKeyReused.description: The idempotency key was already used for a different request. Use a new key.

InternalError.description: A defect in the service. Details are logged, not returned.

BadGateway.description: A dependency of the service answered in a way it cannot handle.

ServiceUnavailable.description: A dependency of the service is unreachable. Retry later.

MessageId.name: x-message-id
MessageId.description: Unique id of this request. Generated when absent.

CorrelationId.name: x-correlation-id
CorrelationId.description: Id shared by every message in one business flow. Defaults to the message id.

CausationId.name: x-causation-id
CausationId.description: Id of the message that caused this request.

IdempotencyKey.name: idempotency-key
IdempotencyKey.description: Caller-chosen key identifying this command across retries. Passed to the handler as `metadata.idempotencyKey`.

CorrelationId.description: Id shared by every message in this business flow.
